identifiers.edge_cases: No universal grammar; may resemble PIID but can contain more separators/text and can be amended without changing base solicitation.

identifiers.name: SAM.gov internal opportunity ID
identifiers.normalization: Lowercase for internal storage if API does.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate via SAM opportunity API.
identifiers.edge_cases: Generic 128-bit hex shape; only accept from SAM URL/JSON field. It is distinct from solicitation_number.

identifiers.name: Treasury Agency Identifier (AID)
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup Treasury agency identifier list and effective dates.
identifiers.edge_cases: Three digits are meaningless without field context; allocation-transfer agency ID is a separate component using the same code list.

identifiers.name: Agency Location Code (ALC)
identifiers.canonical_form: Numeric code with length defined by Treasury system/reference data
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup in Treasury ALC master data.
identifiers.edge_cases: Length varies across legacy/current contexts; do not strip leading zeros or infer agency from prefix without lookup.

identifiers.name: Business Event Type Code (BETC)
identifiers.canonical_form: Up to eight uppercase alphanumeric characters in controlled list
identifiers.semantic_validation: Exact lookup in Treasury BETC reference table; include effective dates.
identifiers.edge_cases: Regex cannot distinguish a BETC from ordinary short codes; codes can be added/retired.

identifiers.name: Common Government-wide Accounting Classification agency code (CGAC)
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup current/historical CGAC table.
identifiers.edge_cases: Organizational reorganizations and independent agencies require effective-date tracking; lexical shape collides with AID/FIPS.

identifiers.name: Federal Reporting Entity Code (FREC)
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup Treasury FREC reference data.
identifiers.edge_cases: Not equivalent to CGAC/AID; shape collides with years and account codes.

identifiers.name: Treasury main account code
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate in combination with agency/availability/subaccount.
identifiers.edge_cases: Not globally unique by itself.

identifiers.name: Treasury subaccount code
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate in complete TAS.
identifiers.edge_cases: Often 000; not globally unique.

identifiers.name: Treasury Account Symbol / String TAS
identifiers.canonical_form: Allocation-transfer agency, agency ID, availability, main account, subaccount components
identifiers.normalization: Parse into official component fields; preserve source string because separator conventions differ.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate components/effective period against Treasury reference data.
identifiers.edge_cases: Display 'String TAS' and componentized TAS differ; optional allocation-transfer agency, X/no-year availability, and subaccount notation create many forms.

identifiers.name: USAspending generated award ID
identifiers.canonical_form: Platform prefix + source award ID + agency/account discriminator
identifiers.normalization: Uppercase prefix; otherwise preserve platform value.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Resolve through USAspending API and retain native PIID/FAIN separately.
identifiers.edge_cases: Generated IDs are platform joins, not issuer-native legal identifiers; source IDs can contain underscores/hyphens.

identifiers.name: DFARS case number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup Defense Acquisition Regulations cases.
identifiers.edge_cases: Interim/final rules and class deviations have different identifiers.

identifiers.name: FAR case number
identifiers.normalization: Uppercase FAR label; preserve zero padding.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup FAR cases/Federal Register RIN crosswalk.
identifiers.edge_cases: A FAR case can generate multiple proposed/final/correction documents; case ID is not an FR Doc number or RIN.

identifiers.name: Federal Acquisition Regulation citation
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate against Acquisition.gov/eCFR and current deviation status.
identifiers.edge_cases: Agency supplements reuse the same numeric scheme with prefixes; clauses have prescriptions and alternates.

identifiers.name: Agency rulemaking docket number (generic open class)
identifiers.required_context: Require explicit docket label and issuer.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Use agency registry/API; no cross-government grammar.
identifiers.edge_cases: Docket prefixes, year placement, separators and sequence lengths vary by agency and system. Regulations.gov IDs are only one major family.

identifiers.name: Code of Federal Regulations citation
identifiers.issuer: GPO / Office of the Federal Register
identifiers.normalization: Normalize reporter to CFR; store title, part, section and subsection separately.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Title must be 1–50; validate edition/current eCFR hierarchy and reserved/removed status.
identifiers.edge_cases: Subparts/appendices/tables and 'et seq.' need parser logic; current eCFR and annual editions are not identical snapshots.

identifiers.name: Executive Order number
identifiers.normalization: Normalize label to Executive Order and integer number.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup official Presidential Documents/Federal Register disposition tables.
identifiers.edge_cases: Numbering conventions changed historically; amendments/revocations do not create a new identity for the original order.

identifiers.name: National security presidential directive identifier
identifiers.issuer: Executive Office of the President / NSC
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate series, administration and official release/status.
identifiers.edge_cases: Series restart or change by administration; many directives remain classified or partially released; identical numbers across different prefixes are unrelated.

identifiers.name: Presidential determination number
identifiers.normalization: Zero-padding should follow source; normalize label only.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup Presidential Documents/Federal Register.
identifiers.edge_cases: Some determinations are unnumbered or published under memorandum titles.

identifiers.name: Presidential proclamation number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup official Presidential Documents/Federal Register.
identifiers.edge_cases: Not every historical proclamation follows the modern numbered series; ceremonial text can mention other proclamation numbers.

identifiers.name: FederalRegister.gov agency slug
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup API agency endpoint; names and organizational history change.
identifiers.edge_cases: Generic slug shape; only meaningful in FederalRegister.gov fields/URLs.

identifiers.name: Federal Register citation
identifiers.issuer: Office of the Federal Register / GPO
identifiers.normalization: Normalize reporter to FR and remove page commas; preserve range.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate volume/page/date through FederalRegister.gov or GovInfo.
identifiers.edge_cases: A page cite identifies the start/pin of a document, not the document's stable FR Doc number; annual volume resets.

identifiers.name: Federal Register document number
identifiers.normalization: Uppercase letter prefixes; preserve zero padding.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Authoritative lookup by document_number; do not validate only by year/length.
identifiers.edge_cases: Legacy electronic/prepublication/correction forms coexist; the modern five-digit serial is not universal historically.

identifiers.name: GovInfo CFR granule ID
identifiers.canonical_form: CFR package ID plus collection hierarchy tokens
identifiers.semantic_validation: Dereference granule; hierarchy patterns differ across titles/editions.
identifiers.edge_cases: Section punctuation is encoded into tokens; appendix/table IDs are irregular.

identifiers.name: GovInfo CFR volume package ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate title/volume/year via GovInfo.
identifiers.edge_cases: A title can span many physical volumes; volume number is publication-specific and not a CFR part.

identifiers.name: GovInfo Federal Register granule ID
identifiers.canonical_form: Federal Register document number used as granule ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Resolve within the FR issue/package; same lexical family as FR document number.
identifiers.edge_cases: Package context may be needed where legacy numbers collide.

identifiers.name: GovInfo Federal Register issue package ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate issue date in GovInfo.
identifiers.edge_cases: No issue every calendar day.

identifiers.name: OMB Circular number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup current/revised circular and appendices.
identifiers.edge_cases: Revisions keep the same circular number; appendices/attachments need separate version locators.

identifiers.name: OMB control number
identifiers.canonical_form: Four-digit agency family + hyphen + four-digit collection number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup in OIRA information-collection inventory; check expiration/status.
identifiers.edge_cases: Lexically collides with RIN fragments, dockets and local case numbers; label/context is required.

identifiers.name: OMB Information Collection Request reference number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate month, agency/control relationship and lookup in Reginfo.gov.
identifiers.edge_cases: A control number can have many ICR reference submissions over time.

identifiers.name: OMB memorandum number
identifiers.normalization: Uppercase M; preserve displayed zero padding.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup OMB memorandum archive.
identifiers.edge_cases: Publication year generally appears in prefix but corrections/rescissions require lifecycle metadata.

identifiers.name: Daily Compilation of Presidential Documents package ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo package.
identifiers.edge_cases: Year semantics are collection-specific; Weekly Compilation (WCPD) is the predecessor and has a different package grammar.

identifiers.name: Weekly Compilation of Presidential Documents package ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo; do not derive semantics from suffix without metadata.
identifiers.edge_cases: Legacy collection package IDs vary by issue/document granularity.

identifiers.name: Regulations.gov comment ID
identifiers.semantic_validation: Resolve API object type; document/comment ID grammars overlap.
identifiers.edge_cases: Comments can include attached files with separate internal IDs; bulk data may expose IDs not printed in the document.

identifiers.name: Regulations.gov docket ID
identifiers.required_context: Docket label or Regulations.gov URL/API context.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Must be confirmed by Regulations.gov docket endpoint; grammar is agency-defined.
identifiers.edge_cases: No universal token count; agency/component/office/type/year placement varies. The same prefix can appear in document/comment IDs.

identifiers.name: Regulations.gov document ID
identifiers.canonical_form: Usually docket ID + hyphen + item serial
identifiers.semantic_validation: Resolve API object type; do not infer document versus comment solely from suffix.
identifiers.edge_cases: Comment IDs often share exactly the same lexical shape; migrated/legacy records can depart from the common docket-plus-serial pattern.

identifiers.name: Regulations.gov internal object ID
identifiers.required_context: Only accept in Regulations.gov JSON/URL fields.
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate via API metadata; do not treat arbitrary 16-hex strings as Regulations.gov IDs.
identifiers.edge_cases: Generic hex collision risk is extreme; objectId is a platform key, not the printed agency identifier.

identifiers.name: Regulations.gov submission tracking key
identifiers.semantic_validation: Validate only in submission API/workflow.
identifiers.edge_cases: Opaque and not guaranteed stable as a public citation; broad shape collides with many IDs.

identifiers.name: Regulation Identifier Number (RIN)
identifiers.canonical_form: Four digits, hyphen, two letters, two digits
identifiers.semantic_validation: Lookup in Reginfo.gov; verify agency prefix and title.
identifiers.edge_cases: RIN normally persists from Unified Agenda through rulemaking stages, but withdrawn/transferred/merged items and reused text references require lifecycle data.

identifiers.name: Unified Agenda sequence number
identifiers.semantic_validation: Require agenda edition/agency; never treat as stable cross-edition identity.
identifiers.edge_cases: Sequence numbers change by edition and are locators, unlike RINs.
